comment: The counterweight to "capture once, use many times" is missing where it is introduced. REDDHI is Resilient Essential Data; "Essential" now governs only the floor (data that must exist). We suggest extending it to the ceiling too — capturing and sharing only what is essential, minimised at source. Principle VIII already makes minimisation the default "with any departure justified" (p.34); the goals narrative and the central-pull data flows read as unjustified departures. We recommend naming minimisation, purpose-limitation, and need-based disclosure in the "Governed well" framing, and preferring minimisation at source.

reviewer.organisation: CoWEAVE - Medtronic LABS; eGov Foundation; Open Healthcare Network Foundation
